purpose: Read-only compile the exact fresh rendered-browser goal and expose its decomposition/causal binding frontier.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
def load(name,path):
 s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,path); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); sys.modules[s.name]=m; s.loader.exec_module(m); return m
g=load('goal_compile_diag','canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=("Using a real rendered browser, open https://www.python.org/downloads/. Determine the latest stable Python 3 release shown on the page. "
"Save a full-page screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYTHON_DOWNLOADS.png and save canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYTHON_DOWNLOADS_RESULT.json "
"containing source_url, final_url, page_title, latest_stable_python3, and observed_text_evidence. Finally independently verify from the official Python "
"downloads page, without trusting the browser extraction, that the claimed latest_stable_python3 string is present and corresponds to the current stable Python 3 release shown there.")
out={'clauses':g.decompose_goal(goal)}
try: out['compiled']=g.compile_goal(goal,reg,root)
except Exception as e: out['compile_error']=type(e).__name__+':'+str(e)
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
print('BROWSER_COMPILE_DIAG_COMPLETE')
PY
